subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace discovery silently skip oversized hook metadata, or emit an operator-visible diagnostic identifying the rejected hook and limit?
rationale: The size cap is sound hardening, but choosing silent compatibility behavior versus actionable diagnostics affects operators and cannot be inferred safely from the helper implementation alone.

options.title: Emit a bounded warning
options.body: Use the canonical reader and report the rejected metadata path and size limit without reading or loading the hook.

options.title: Preserve silent skipping
options.body: Use the canonical reader but intentionally retain the existing null-and-skip behavior for all invalid or oversized workspace metadata.

recommendation.title: Emit a bounded warning
recommendation.body: Use the canonical reader and report the rejected metadata path and size limit without reading or loading the hook.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available recent history across both affected hook metadata paths, though final product-policy approval should come from an OpenClaw maintainer.
